text: At the invitation of the Chair, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee, Mayor John Tory will address the Committee.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. City Council request the Mayor to establish a task force on Accessible Housing. 2. The Executive Committee direct the City Manager to report to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee with information on all accessibility initiatives that have been approved as part of the 2022 approved budget, as well as those being considered, undertaken or planned for the City of Toronto, along with timelines and necessary funding required for implementation, to allow for the Committee's input on priorities.
